# "Not for Sale": Federation Embassy Takes Note

NEW VELDRANIA — President Vento's declaration that Kunasai's harbours and laws are "not for sale, not to the Arennian Federation, not to Zharan" was received politely in both embassies. An Arennian official, asked for comment, said the Federation "has never sought to buy anything that was not already on offer". The Zharani mission did not comment.
